Recipes 103

The moves award-winning sites keep repeating, each built once in plain Vite, pinned to its libraries and driven through its states in headless Chromium.

102 focused recipes and one complete composition; 76 carry a recorded pass. Open one to run it live beside its source, scrub through its scroll, and read why it is built the way it is. The plugin's skills adapt them to a project's own world; they are never pasted.

Run them

Every recipe is a small Vite page with its own README, manifest and verifier. From plugins/awards/recipes:

npm install
npm run dev                              # this index, every recipe live
node ../scripts/verify-recipes.mjs --only scroll-pin-scrub

This page is generated by scripts/build-gallery.mjs from the manifests; its frames come from scripts/gallery-frames.mjs, shot at 1440 × 900 in headless Chromium with software WebGL, which proves a recipe works, not that it is fast.

Recipes, frames and this page are the plugin's own work under the MIT licence.
